# Raven Nexus Business Setup commercial intent cluster

Public ID: raven-nexus-business-setup-v1
Problem: A small business owner has important work split across email, documents, payments, customer records, credentials and AI tools, with no clean source-of-truth or permission map, and needs a bounded founder-led setup instead of another rip-and-replace software project.
Pricing: Founding Business Systems Map $500 one-time; Connected Business Implementation $1,500 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Human review: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/raven-nexus-business-setup-v1/index.html
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/raven-nexus-business-setup-v1/

## Brand-blind user language

- connect the tools my business already uses
- my business systems are scattered across too many apps
- organize Gmail Drive payments documents and AI for my business
- make AI understand my business safely
- set up an AI-ready source of truth for my business
- map who has access to what in my business
- connect my business systems without replacing everything
- small business AI operating layer
- Raven Nexus Business

## Boundary

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
